display.name: FastMCP triage
display.description: Claude Code on laptop-pool. Cost is Claude's API-equivalent estimate on a Max subscription, not a billed charge. Telemetry begins with the observability deployment; older runs remain in Prefect. Unfinished includes running and interrupted jobs, within the selected time range.

spec.query: SELECT attributes->>'status' AS outcome, count(*) AS runs FROM records WHERE service_name = 'fastmcp-triage' AND message = 'fastmcp triage finished' GROUP BY outcome

SELECT start_timestamp, attributes->>'status' AS outcome, attributes->>'publish_prs' AS publishing, attributes->>'error_type' AS error, (attributes->>'duration_seconds')::double AS seconds, (attributes->>'candidates')::bigint AS candidates, (attributes->>'triaged')::bigint AS triaged, (attributes->>'skipped')::bigint AS skipped, (attributes->>'failed')::bigint AS failed, (attributes->>'blocked')::bigint AS blocked, (attributes->>'prs')::bigint AS prs, (attributes->>'cost_usd')::double AS estimated_cost_usd, attributes->>'usage' AS plan_usage, attributes->>'run_url' AS run FROM records WHERE service_name = 'fastmcp-triage' AND message = 'fastmcp triage finished' ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT start_timestamp, attributes->>'number' AS thread, attributes->>'outcome' AS outcome, attributes->>'publish_prs' AS publishing, (attributes->>'duration_seconds')::double AS seconds, (attributes->>'cost_usd')::double AS estimated_cost_usd, attributes->>'reason' AS skip_reason, attributes->>'action' AS agent_advice, attributes->>'pr_url' AS pull_request, attributes->>'session_id' AS claude_session, attributes->>'error_type' AS error, attributes->>'run_url' AS run FROM records WHERE service_name = 'fastmcp-triage' AND message = 'fastmcp triage thread' ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT s.start_timestamp, s.attributes->>'run_url' AS run FROM records s WHERE s.service_name = 'fastmcp-triage' AND s.message = 'fastmcp triage started' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM records f WHERE f.service_name = 'fastmcp-triage' AND f.message = 'fastmcp triage finished' AND f.attributes->>'run_id' = s.attributes->>'run_id') ORDER BY s.start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
